FAQ

SEO Questions, Answered

The questions Edmonton business owners ask us most, with straight answers.

Getting started

General questions

Straight answers to the questions Edmonton business owners ask us most.

How long does SEO take to show results?

It depends on your site, your competition and how much work is needed. Google suggests asking any SEO provider what results they expect and in what timeframe, so we answer that in writing after your audit, based on what we find. We do not promise dates we cannot back up.

Can you guarantee a #1 ranking on Google?

No. Google states that no one can guarantee a #1 ranking, and we agree. What we commit to is a clear plan, the work we said we would do and honest monthly reporting on rankings, traffic and leads.

Do you only work with Edmonton businesses?

Our focus is Edmonton and the businesses that serve customers here. That focus is what lets us learn local search results closely, neighbourhood by neighbourhood.

Will we own everything you create?

Yes. Content, technical fixes, reports and account access stay with you. We work inside your own Google Search Console, Google Analytics and Google Business Profile accounts.

Will you tell us every change you make to our site?

Yes. Every change is logged and shared with you. Google lists this as one of the questions to ask an SEO, and we think it should be standard.

Local search

Local SEO and Google Business Profile

Straight answers to the questions Edmonton business owners ask us most.

What affects my ranking in Google Maps?

Google says local ranking is based mainly on relevance, distance and prominence. Prominence includes things like links to your business and your review count. See our Local SEO page for how we work on each.

Can I pay Google for a better local ranking?

No. Google states there is no way to request or pay for a better local ranking. Ads are a separate product.

Do reviews help local rankings?

Google says more reviews and positive ratings can help your local ranking, and recommends responding to reviews. We help you build a steady, genuine review process.

Do I need a page for every Edmonton neighbourhood?

Only where you have something useful and unique to say. Google treats pages built only to rank for similar city or region searches as doorway abuse, so we build location pages with real substance or not at all.

Working together

Process and reporting

Straight answers to the questions Edmonton business owners ask us most.

What do monthly reports include?

Rankings for your target keywords, organic traffic, Business Profile activity and leads, with a short summary of what we did and what comes next.

Do you need access to our website?

Usually yes, so we can make fixes directly. If you prefer, we can hand changes to your developer instead.

How do we get started?

Book a free SEO review. We will look at your site, then propose a plan.

Still have a question?

Ask us directly. We usually reply within one business day.
